recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.release/d ; /signingConfigs \{/,/^    \}/d' -i app/build.gradle
chmod +x gradlew
./gradlew assembleRelease --warning-mode none -x lint -x test
find . -name '*.apk'
mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
